name: Narcissism
overview: Scripture reveals that narcissism stems from a heart devoid of the fear of God, leading to pride and a deceitful, wicked nature as seen in Psalms 36:1 and Jeremiah 17:9. The Proverbs passages warn that a haughty spirit precedes destruction and downfall, emphasizing humility as the path to honor. Furthermore, the restless mischief of the proud disrupts peace and relationships, underscoring the biblical call to avoid association with anger and fury. Together, these verses highlight the spiritual danger of self-centered pride and the necessity of humility before God.
